bias.zh: 反弹 · 重回 10 日均线上方，仍低于 $1,546

read.en: ASML rose 1.8% on Nov 11 to $1,534.42, trading $1,517.11–1,563.46. It is above the 5-day ($1,467.4) and 10-day ($1,515.3) and below the 30-day ($1,642.4), 100-day ($1,712.7) and 200-day ($1,601.6); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($1,358.86), and RSI is 45.

The close cleared the 10-day and the $1,530.6 Jul 29 low, now support, but the $1,563.46 high faded back under $1,545.7–1,547 (Nov 10 high, Nov 3 low). Resistance is $1,545.7–1,547, then $1,572.8–1,575.6 (Sep 14 low, Nov 3 high) and $1,600.8–1,601.6 (Nov 2 high, 200-day). Support is $1,515–1,531, then $1,468–1,492 and $1,444–1,467. A close above $1,547 would target $1,573–1,576; below $1,515, $1,468–1,492.

s.en: 10-day average $1,515.3; Nov 11 low $1,517.11; Jul 29 low $1,530.64, reclaimed
